motivation.exact_passage: The use of mechanical shutters in biosensors is a known concept in the field of biosensors, as seen in the closest prior art (US20110215414A1) which discusses the use of transistors and their connections. The secondary reference (US20090131732A1) does not directly relate to biosensors, but the concept of using a composition to render something unfit for consumption can be seen as analogous to the idea of using a mechanical shutter to control the flow of biological samples in a biosensor.

This established knowledge in the art provides a motivation to combine the closest prior art with the secondary reference.
